scores.tell: Chair fabric and armrests lit smoothly, but the metal legs have sharp specular glints and a hard-edged cast shadow on the floor.
Slide has soft, broad sheen and gentle form turn. The water glints and the tiled ground shine a bit glossy.
Dish has a crisp white hot-spot sheen and the red tower is smooth and plasticky. The sand shadows are fairly dramatic.
Soft turn on the wood arrows with a gentle shadow side. A slight sharp rim on the arrow edges.
Glass has many sharp white specular streaks and bright speckles. The cast shadow on the table is a bit hard.
Glossy dome highlight and a smooth gradient on the saucer, in the same style as the real cards. The lights are slightly shiny.
Stone table and stools have soft, even shading but are a little flat and textured. The cast shadows are dark green blobs.
Soft sails and hull shaded well with gentle turn. The water foam highlights are a little busy.
Soft form turn on the door and foliage with warm bounce. The leaf highlights are slightly numerous.
Gravestone is a smooth, waxy gray-blue slab with a broad glossy sheen on its edges and an even gradient. It looks like a statue, with a flat, cold shadow side.
